title: Concept: Shell command executed through callCommand or callShell in haskell — review required
description: In haskell, a shell-based process helper is used. The Haskell process API distinguishes shell helpers from argument-based ones by name, which makes this pattern a precise signal. Once a request value reaches the string, the shell decides where commands begin.
applicability: haskell tooling and services that call external programs.
risk: Shell injection with process privileges; HIGH severity.
